title: Quality is ok, decent for price.
text: Quality is ok, decent for price.. The quality isn't great, so you get what you pay for. Color and size is nice. One towel had a sticker on it and when I removed it, a thread pulled out and caused a snag. A little annoying. And after a wash, the softness suffered. But we just needed towels for A powder room, so the quality wasn't our main concern.

product_metadata.title: Classic Turkish Towels - Luxury Bath Towels, 100% Turkish Cotton, Thick and Absorbent Bathroom Towels, Antalya Collection, 4-Piece Set - 27 x 54 Inches (Aqua)
features: ✅ 𝐋𝐮𝐱𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐡 𝐓𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐬: Enjoy the quality of hotel and spa towels in the comfort of your home with these bath towels made of 100% Turkish cotton.
✅ 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐀𝐛𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐧𝐭: The high-quality cotton material allows for maximum absorbency. These towels dry quickly between uses and are perfect for drying your body, face, and hair.
✅ 𝐋𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐲 & 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭: Our 600 GSM bathroom towels feel ultra-soft and plush against your skin while remaining thick and durable for long-term use.
✅ 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡-𝐐𝐮𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐒𝐞𝐭: Includes 4 standard 27-by-54-inch towels, specially combed to retain only the finest and longest fibers. They’re OEKO-TEX certified and chemical free.
✅ 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐓𝐢𝐩𝐬: To extend the longevity of your luxury bath towels, machine-wash in warm or cold water. Always wash before first use to improve absorbency and softness. Avoid bleach and fabric softener.
